about:
Imperial Woodworking Company operates from Palatine, Illinois, and traces its origins to 1963. The business has been described as a family-owned enterprise since its founding, though the founders' names are not publicly disclosed. It began as a woodworking shop focused on delivering quality craftsmanship for commercial projects.

The firm specializes in architectural woodworking, producing custom millwork, casework, and finish carpentry for large-scale projects. Its facility size and headcount are not disclosed, but the company emphasizes a hands-on approach from project inception through installation. Capabilities include design collaboration, fabrication, and on-site coordination.

Primary clients are design professionals—architects and interior designers—and general contractors managing commercial, institutional, and high-end residential projects. The company's project portfolio includes work for notable clients, though specific names are not listed in public materials.

Imperial Woodworking distinguishes itself through a commitment to quality, service, and dependability, values cited since its early years. The company highlights a personal level of attention that permeates each project, supported by a collaborative process that integrates with design teams and construction schedules.
